# T&J Waterfront Services

> Dock & hoist sales, installs, removals, seawalls, beaches, patios, retaining walls, landscaping and more across Michigan. We have a variety of services in Michigan! Give us a call today!

T&J Waterfront Services LLC installs, maintains and repairs docks, boat lifts, seawalls, patios, beaches, retaining walls and shorelines across Michigan. One trusted team for your entire lakefront, serving Howell, Brighton, Ann Arbor, Flint, Traverse City and 45+ more communities.

- Phone: (517) 294-5577
- Email: tjwaterfrontservices@gmail.com
- Address: 5385 Mack Rd, Howell, MI 48855
- Hours: 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 7 days a week

## Services
- [Landscaping](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/landscaping): Lawn and business landscaping — from small garden work to complete yard redesigns and new home builds.
- [Seawalls](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/seawalls): Steel, boulder, ledge rock and rip rap seawalls that stop shoreline erosion. 6-month labor warranty.
- [Retaining Walls](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/retaining-walls): Boulder, ledge rock, slate rock, wood, timber, block and brick walls that hold land and add appeal.
- [Patios](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/patios): Patio options for every space — from large expansive areas to small home entrances and walkways.
- [Beaches](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/beaches): Mason sand, 2NS, Florida sand and Santa Barbara beach — any beach, large or small.
- [Decks & Boardwalks](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/decks-boardwalks): Boardwalk walkways over marshland, through yards, to front doors or garages.
- [Dock Services & Repair](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/dock-service): Yearly installs, removals, leveling, stringer repair, storm damage and insurance claim assistance.
- [Hoist Services & Repair](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/services/hoist-service): Cable, winch and pulley repair, hoist trade-ins, lake-to-lake transport, storm damage services.
- [Sectional Docks](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/sectional-docks): Our best seller — the industry leader for docks with strength and light weight.
- [Roll-In Docks](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/roll-in-docks): The easiest dock to install in most situations.
- [Platinum Docks](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/platinum-docks): High-end dock system with soft edges and a classy look.
- [Floating Docks](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/floating-docks): Free-standing floating systems that maintain stability in deeper water.
- [Boat Lifts](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/boat-lifts): Starr boat lifts built with heavy gauge aluminum for strength and long-lasting durability.
- [Dock Accessories](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/dock-accessories): Everything you need about docks and accessories.
- [Boat & Pontoon Lift Accessories](https://tjwaterfrontservices.com/boat-pontoon-lift-accessories): Everything you need for boat and pontoon lifting.
